info.title: CoreUp API
info.description: REST API of the CoreUp platform. Tenant routes need the `cu_session` cookie plus `X-Tenant-Id` (and optionally `X-Branch-Id`); POSTs that create bookings, payments or messages need `Idempotency-Key`. Errors always use `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.
